title: Adopt build_table(hole_safe=True) (from #25460) in every ml_decision_entry consumer: the grade, the diag and the retrain/dataset scripts. Positional rolling features/ATR spanning a bar hole corrupt 168 bars after it. MEASURED: one 2026-10-28 hole moved a 14-day grade from -0.2127 to -0.1316 (n 373 -> 317). Steps: (1) census the historic bar holes in the crypto 1h lake (count, symbols, dates); (2) switch the default to hole-safe and re-grade the affected committed records, recording old vs new; (3) for training sets, rebuild hole-safe and record the feature diff. A served-model retrain follows the normal evidence path. NOT a refusal: a window with a gap is regridded and graded, never refused (operator 2026-11-12, no new gates). Done when the census is committed and every consumer builds hole-safe by default. Gates: none.

decision_requests.evidence: Re-grading ml_entry v1r20261106 with bar gaps handled (hole_safe, #25507/#25460) flips its promotion grade from PASS to FAIL.
